verdict.rationale: Datalab documents pipelines, which are reusable, versioned processor chains deployed to production, along with async jobs that send webhook notifications on completion. Every run is still started by an explicit API call. There is no evidence of scheduled, recurring, or event-triggered automations that run on their own in the background. These are building blocks a developer could orchestrate externally, not the autonomous-automation capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
